controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.narrative: Intercepts all prompt traffic in-memory before reaching LLMs. Evaluates presented object locators against active signed snapshots with zero DB calls.

controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement
controls.narrative: Enforces destination egress classes (internal_only vs commercial_cloud) mapped to target models. Prevents unauthorized egress of sensitive data.

controls.title: Audit Events
controls.narrative: Produces immutable AuditLogEntry containing timestamp, mode, verdict, reason codes, locators, clearance, and sub-millisecond decision latency.

controls.title: Protection of Audit Information
controls.narrative: Audit records are serialized and committed to an append-only WORM cryptographic audit ledger with immutable hash chains.

controls.title: Non-repudiation
controls.mechanism: DSSE RFC 9421 envelopes & Ed25519 keyring verification
controls.narrative: Attestation records and snapshots are encapsulated within DSSE envelopes. Public keys in keyring provide unforgeable non-repudiation.

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.mechanism: In-Memory Prevalidator Gate & Signed Multi-Hop Handoffs
controls.narrative: Payloads transmitted across agent networks are wrapped in <pod:delegate> containers carrying cryptographically chained Ed25519 signatures.

controls.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management
controls.mechanism: Keyring Ed25519 public key management & rotation
controls.narrative: Employs strict Ed25519 asymmetric cryptography with dynamic key discovery, key pinning, and zero-downtime rotation.

controls.title: Cryptographic Protection
controls.mechanism: DSSE v1.0 signature verification & content digest chaining
controls.narrative: Utilizes standard Ed25519 signatures and SHA-256 digests over canonical UTF-8 representations.

controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
controls.mechanism: Snapshot SHA-256 Merkle verification & hash drift detection
controls.narrative: Validates hash integrity of presented prompt payloads against signed snapshot records, blocking tampered payloads immediately.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (organizational Users)
controls.narrative: Authenticates callers using signed JWT tokens or API keys, mapping identities into clearance tiers.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (non-organizational Users)
controls.mechanism: <pod:delegate> provenance chains with accountable root owner
controls.narrative: Autonomous agents must present cryptographically signed delegation envelopes containing verified provenance chains rooted in an accountable human principal.

controls.title: Continuous Monitoring
controls.mechanism: 30-Day Audit Runway Monitor & in-memory state sweepers
controls.narrative: Features continuous in-memory sweepers and an Audit Runway Monitor tracking traffic coverage, denial stability, and triage disposition.
